mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, #{targetYearMonth} AS yearMonth, SUM(d.amount) AS totalAmount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(d.amount) DESC) AS `rank` FROM donation d JOIN member m ON d.member_id = m.member_id WHERE d.donated_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CONCAT(#{targetYearMonth}, '-01 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND d.donated_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CONCAT(#{targetYearMonth}, '-01 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY m.member_id
SELECT r.rank, m.name AS memberName, r.total_amount AS totalAmount FROM ranking r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id WHERE r.`year_month` = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY r.rank ASC LIMIT #{limit}
